'''Jagger''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who lived during the tumultuous period of conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] known as the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Jagger joined [[Corridan Ordo]] and several members of their clan, along with close friend [[Torian Cadera]], on a hunting trip to [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]],<ref name="TOR" /> [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon's]] [[Species/Legends|beast]]-infested [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The Mandalorians hunted mostly [[boma]]s and [[maalraas]], but Jagger managed to take down a [[Zakkeg/Legends|zakkeg]] during the course of the trip. Because of this, Cadera later light-[[Heart/Legends|heartedly]] referred to Jagger as a "lucky ''jare''"<ref name="TOR" />—a Mandalorian term for an almost [[Death/Legends|suicidally]] reckless individual.<ref name="Mando'a">{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/page20/page26/index.html|text=Mando'a|author=Karen Traviss|work=[http://www.karentraviss.com Karen Traviss]|archivedate=20110925083955}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Jagger was first introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', created by [[BioWare]] and released [[December 20]], [[2011]].
